description: Database transaction session fails to truncate subsequent savepoints when rolling back to an ancestor savepoint, violating SQL-92 isolation.
spec_notes: TransactionSession.rollback_to_savepoint must purge all savepoints created after the target savepoint.

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict


@dataclass
class Savepoint:
    name: str
    snapshot_data: Dict[str, Any]
repo_files.transaction.py:
"""Transaction session with nested savepoint support."""

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from connection import DBConnection
from savepoint import Savepoint


class TransactionSession:
    def __init__(self, conn: DBConnection):
        self.conn = conn
        self.active_data: Dict[str, Any] = dict(conn.storage)
        self.savepoints: List[Savepoint] = []
        self.is_active: bool = True

    def create_savepoint(self, name: str) -> None:
        # Capture immutable snapshot
        sp = Savepoint(name=name, snapshot_data=dict(self.active_data))
        self.savepoints.append(sp)

    def rollback_to_savepoint(self, name: str) -> bool:
        target_idx = -1
        for i, sp in enumerate(self.savepoints):
            if sp.name == name:
                target_idx = i
                break
        if target_idx == -1:
            return False

        target_sp = self.savepoints[target_idx]
        self.active_data = dict(target_sp.snapshot_data)
        # BUG: Fails to remove subsequent savepoints defined after target_idx,
        # leaving orphaned future savepoints on the stack!
        return True

    def commit(self) -> None:
        if not self.is_active:
            raise RuntimeError("Transaction is inactive")
        self.conn.storage = dict(self.active_data)
        self.is_active = False

    def rollback(self) -> None:
        self.active_data = dict(self.conn.storage)
        self.savepoints.clear()
        self.is_active = False

tests.test_db_savepoints.py:
from connection import DBConnection
from manager import TransactionManager


def test_basic_commit_persists():
    conn = DBConnection()
    mgr = TransactionManager(conn)
    tx = mgr.begin()
    mgr.write_record("user_1", {"name": "Alice"})
    tx.commit()
    assert conn.storage["user_1"] == {"name": "Alice"}


def test_savepoint_partial_rollback():
    conn = DBConnection()
    mgr = TransactionManager(conn)
    tx = mgr.begin()
    mgr.write_record("k1", "v1")
    tx.create_savepoint("sp_1")
    mgr.write_record("k2", "v2")
    assert mgr.read_record("k2") == "v2"
    # Rollback to sp_1: k2 should be discarded, k1 kept
    res = tx.rollback_to_savepoint("sp_1")
    assert res is True
    assert mgr.read_record("k1") == "v1"
    assert mgr.read_record("k2") is None
    tx.commit()
    assert "k1" in conn.storage
    assert "k2" not in conn.storage


def test_nested_savepoints_truncates_downstream_stack():
    conn = DBConnection()
    mgr = TransactionManager(conn)
    tx = mgr.begin()
    mgr.write_record("a", 1)
    tx.create_savepoint("sp_a")
    mgr.write_record("b", 2)
    tx.create_savepoint("sp_b")
    mgr.write_record("c", 3)
    tx.create_savepoint("sp_c")
    # Rolling back to sp_a must purge sp_b and sp_c from stack!
    tx.rollback_to_savepoint("sp_a")
    assert [sp.name for sp in tx.savepoints] == ["sp_a"]
    # Attempting to rollback to sp_b must now fail (it was purged)
    assert tx.rollback_to_savepoint("sp_b") is False


def test_rollback_nonexistent_savepoint_returns_false():
    conn = DBConnection()
    mgr = TransactionManager(conn)
    tx = mgr.begin()
    assert tx.rollback_to_savepoint("sp_missing") is False


def test_full_rollback_discards_all_uncommitted():
    conn = DBConnection()
    conn.storage["init"] = "val"
    mgr = TransactionManager(conn)
    tx = mgr.begin()
    mgr.write_record("k_new", "temp")
    tx.rollback()
    assert "k_new" not in conn.storage
    assert conn.storage["init"] == "val"


def test_duplicate_savepoint_name_replaces_snapshot():
    conn = DBConnection()
    mgr = TransactionManager(conn)
    tx = mgr.begin()
    mgr.write_record("x", 10)
    tx.create_savepoint("sp_x")
    mgr.write_record("x", 20)
    tx.create_savepoint("sp_x")  # Replaces previous sp_x with x=20
    mgr.write_record("x", 30)
    tx.rollback_to_savepoint("sp_x")
    assert mgr.read_record("x") == 20


def test_read_outside_transaction_reads_connection_storage():
    conn = DBConnection()
    conn.storage["persisted"] = 999
    mgr = TransactionManager(conn)
    assert mgr.read_record("persisted") == 999

"""Transaction session with nested savepoint support."""

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
from connection import DBConnection
from savepoint import Savepoint


class TransactionSession:
    def __init__(self, conn: DBConnection):
        self.conn = conn
        self.active_data: Dict[str, Any] = dict(conn.storage)
        self.savepoints: List[Savepoint] = []
        self.is_active: bool = True

    def create_savepoint(self, name: str) -> None:
        # Remove existing savepoint with same name if already present
        self.savepoints = [sp for sp in self.savepoints if sp.name != name]
        sp = Savepoint(name=name, snapshot_data=dict(self.active_data))
        self.savepoints.append(sp)

    def rollback_to_savepoint(self, name: str) -> bool:
        target_idx = -1
        for i, sp in enumerate(self.savepoints):
            if sp.name == name:
                target_idx = i
                break
        if target_idx == -1:
            return False

        target_sp = self.savepoints[target_idx]
        self.active_data = dict(target_sp.snapshot_data)
        # Truncate savepoints stack to target_idx + 1 (keeping target savepoint, purging newer ones)
        self.savepoints = self.savepoints[: target_idx + 1]
        return True

    def commit(self) -> None:
        if not self.is_active:
            raise RuntimeError("Transaction is inactive")
        self.conn.storage = dict(self.active_data)
        self.is_active = False

    def rollback(self) -> None:
        self.active_data = dict(self.conn.storage)
        self.savepoints.clear()
        self.is_active = False
